recommendation: Keep the published fix as-is. It completes the un-applied part of the final Jira decision with a minimal build-scoped source change and avoids duplicating the pronunciation note on every audience-specific overview page.
issue_request: FHIR-17270 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked FHIR-core to replace inconsistent spell-outs of FHIR as Fast Health Interoperability Resources with Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources and add guidance that FHIR is pronounced "fire".
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision 14455. In Git, commit e61754b55eeede373d97591c958794a706f74884 fixed the acronym expansion in source/overview-dev.html and source/overview-clinical.html, but no pronunciation sentence was added.
additional_context: Current core source no longer contains the misspelled expansion. The general overview page is in current build/navigation scope through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini and is linked from source/index.html and source/documentation.html. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Added one central sentence to source/overview.html: FHIR is pronounced "fire". No other source files needed changes because the spelling correction was already applied and no remaining core-source misspelling was found.
source_changes: source/overview.html: added the sentence `FHIR is pronounced "fire".` immediately after the main FHIR expansion in the general overview introduction.

evidence_items.summary: The GF#17270/SVN r14455 commit corrected Fast Health to Fast Healthcare in source/overview-dev.html and source/overview-clinical.html.

evidence_items.learned: This central build-scoped page is the right place to apply the missing pronunciation guidance without duplicating it across parallel overview pages.
